subject: Post-Signature Handoff: Implementation Impact Map & Owner Matrix
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@medfolio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-Signature Handoff: Implementation Impact Map & Owner Matrix

Hi Lena —

Congrats again on getting the contract over the finish line. Quick handoff note from Sales to kick off implementation planning and make sure we’re aligned on owners, major integrations, and known risks before the signing team hands over to CS.

Summary / immediate asks:
- Primary objective: P0 go-live for core chat + embeddings for chart summarization by 2026-08-15.
- What we delivered: Redwood Dedicated, data-in-region (us-east), SOC2 scope included in SOW.
- Key integrations: MedFolio EHR (FHIR API v1.2), S3 archive, Okta SSO (SAML).

Attached: MedFolio_SOW_v1.pdf, integration-impact-map.xlsx (draft), deployment-window-proposal.csv

Internal notes (for CS/implementation owners) — please keep private:
- Pricing: annual committed capacity; finance is working on the final amendment with procurement.
- Customer expectations: Lena’s execs expect a production pilot with real clinical traffic by mid-August; they have limited engineering bandwidth and asked for an implementation lead from Redwood to coordinate.
- Risk flags:
  * EHR API rate limits — customer advised current sandbox is throttled and they need migration support.
  * Okta team needs cert exchange; internal security review typically takes ~10 business days.

Marissa — assigning you as primary CS owner. Karthik, please nominate the implementation engineer and confirm timeline feasibility; Mina, can you surface any capacity constraints for Dedicated pool in us-east for Aug?

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal kickoff (Redwood): Marissa, Karthik, Mina — 2x30m sync next week to assign leads and finalize engineer names.
2) External kickoff (MedFolio + Redwood): Marissa + assigned engineer + Lena + technical contact — schedule for the week of 2026-05-11.
3) Delivery milestones and preflight checklist to be circulated by CS within 72 hours of internal kickoff.

Thanks all — I’ll remain on-thread for the first two sprints to help unblock procurement/exec asks.

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-Signature Handoff: Implementation Impact Map & Owner Matrix

Thanks Ben — and congrats, Lena and team.

Ben: I’ll take primary CS ownership. Internal goals for our kickoff: validate contract scope, confirm infra reservations, map EHR endpoints and data flows, and capture acceptance criteria for pilot.

I’ve pulled an initial owner matrix below (tentative):
- CS Lead: Marissa Cole (owner of onboarding, adoption metrics, acceptance criteria)
- Implementation Engineer: TBD — @karthik please confirm an engineer from the integration squad (ideally someone with FHIR experience).
- Platform Ops Lead (Dedicated): Mina Haddad — will confirm pool reservation and any blackout windows.

Lena — two quick clarifying items so we can lock the impact map before internal kickoff:
1) Can you share the FHIR sandbox base URL and whether there is a proxy in front of it that enforces rate limits?
2) Any firm blackout dates for your clinical teams between July 20–Aug 10?

I’ll pull together a preflight checklist and draft runbook (includes SSO tasks, cert exchange owners, and a minimum viable dataset for pilot) once Karthik confirms the engineer.

Proposed internal sync: Mon 2026-05-04 10:00–10:30 PT. OK for everyone?

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: MedFolio Technical <tech@medfolio.com>

Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-Signature Handoff: Implementation Impact Map & Owner Matrix

Marissa — thanks for the note. Quick responses from the tech side: 

- Sandbox FHIR base: https://sandbox.medfolio.internal/fhir (API key-based auth currently; will need to move to Okta-proxied SAML flow for production).
- Rate limiting: sandbox enforces 60 requests/minute and returns standard 429. Production limits are higher but will still require batching on your side for high-throughput jobs (we can share historical daily request profiles).
- Blackout window: Clinical change freeze Aug 1–Aug 9 (cannot perform writes to production during that period). Read-only is allowed.

Can we get the specific list of endpoints Redwood intends to call for the initial pilot? We'll map owners on our side and surface any additional compliance checks.

—
MedFolio Tech (on behalf of Victor Ramos)
tech@medfolio.com

Thanks team — I can confirm an implementation engineer: Rajesh Kumar (integration squad). Rajesh has prior FHIR integration experience and handled our last EHR rollout.

Action items I’m taking on now: 
- Rajesh to connect with MedFolio tech (Victor) to collect endpoint list and sandbox creds by Wed 2026-05-06 EOD.
- I’ll draft a 6-week sprint plan (pilot scope, M1–M3 acceptance criteria) and share by Thu 2026-05-07.
- Coordinate with Platform (Mina) to reserve Dedicated capacity for Aug pilot week; flagging that we may need a small burst pool if ingestion spikes.

Mina — any immediate capacity issues? If you confirm, I’ll schedule the external kickoff for next week.

—
